topic.title: Profile Settings Page
topic.shortdesc: Use the profile settings page to view account details, manage notifications, and update personal preferences.

body.p: To open the profile settings page, click your user name in the top-right corner of the interface, then select Profile from the drop-down menu. This page shows your name, email address, and avatar. It also lets you delete your account and choose which types of email notifications you want to receive.

dlentry.dd: This section displays information about your Name and Email.
Use this option to set the UI language.

dlentry.dt: User Role (only available in evaluation versions)
dlentry.dd: Use this option to set your platform user role. In Enterprise versions, this setting is controlled by an administrator.

These options control which types of email notifications you receive:
New messages are added on review tasks assigned to me.
New messages are added on review tasks owned by me.
Review tasks owned by me are finalized by a reviewer.
New reviewers are assigned to public tasks owned by me.
A file is modified by a collaborator on a review task owned by me or assigned to me - When this option is selected, the system sends a periodic email (20-minute intervals after an edit is detected) that includes details about file modifications that have been made by others since the last email interval. The email contains a summary of file and review-comment modifications made by other collaborators, information about the type of changes and who made them, and a preview of comments that were added or changed within files during the interval. A link to the activity page for the particular task is also included.

Enable tree editing in the Publications side-view - When selected (default), the publications tree can be edited in a specialized DITA map tree editor. When not selected, the publications tree is displayed as read-only.
Permanently deletes your account. A confirmation dialog box is displayed to help prevent accidental deletion.

section.title: Other Email Notifications
section.p:
You will also receive automatic email notifications in other situations, including:
When you are invited to collaborate on a task.
When the due date for a task is updated.
When the due date for a task is within 3 days, 1 day, or 12 hours of its expiration. In this situation, the email notification is sent to any reviewers who have not finalized the task.
